question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What do you think of Taylor as a nerd?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe Hannah and Zach just stopped by randomly to mock us.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: They do that every day...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? How can you stand it? Just enduring that humiliation once got me so mad!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Such jeers can be overcome... Through the power of imagination!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... You're not talking about `reading` or something, are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... You're not talking about [color=#3b78e2][i]reading[/i][/color] or something, are you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Andrew is actually referring to 'Ogres and Elves'.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Role-playing can be a great way to escape the real world...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You should play with us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A spot's opened up in the party now that Ben has leveled up to 'popular' in real life!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No way! I'll sit here, but I'm `not` playing.
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! I'll sit here, but I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] playing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No way.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Never!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Never![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... Nerd Alert! `Weee Oooo.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah... Nerd Alert! [color=#3b78e2][i]Weee Oooo.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I bet these guys have never kissed a girl!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know that's not true...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa! Did you hear that? Your 'nerd alert' is even more advanced than Hannah's!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Good to see that you're helping keep these dweebs in place.
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That went great!
She turns to see the nerds looking sadly at her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We welcomed you to our beautiful table.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought you'd changed... But I guess you're still the same.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on... Don't look at me with those eyes.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sorry, okay? Geez. Get over it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're still dating `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're still dating [color=#3b78e2][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! I'm a human being!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: When you talk, it sounds like a baby bird chirping.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This is getting depressing.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Let's go blast pop music next to the rebels' table.
Hannah and Zach leave.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks for sticking by us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're just like glue!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But please never compare me to glue again, okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Silence!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You have answered `incorrectly` and thus must don this `Pendant of Shameful Silence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have answered [color=#e23b3b][i]incorrectly[/i][/color] and thus must don this [color=#e23b3b][i]Pendant of Shameful Silence![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik reaches into his pocket and hands over...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A 'Vote for Sara' button hanging from a piece of dental floss?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Silence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Silence![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That face is `angry` not `shameful!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That face is [color=#e23b3b][i]angry[/i][/color] not [color=#e23b3b][i]shameful![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, guys, that's enough. Give Erik his button back.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: One day, it'll be a collector's item!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So... Uh... I can talk again?
Just then, Hannah and Zach walk by.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Beep, beep, beep. My `nerd alert` is going off.
nodes.text_bbcode: Beep, beep, beep. My [color=#3b78e2][i]nerd alert[/i][/color] is going off.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. 'Beep'.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This 'nerd alert' is a highly implausible device. To quantify a personality trait is practically...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `BEEP!` These readings are off the chart!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]BEEP![/i][/color] These readings are off the chart!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! 'Chart'.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait a second... `Taylor?` What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor?[/i][/color] What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

options.label: Making fun of the nerds too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's obvious! If you're very powerful, you must be Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That is incorrect. I don't even know what that is.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? How could you not...?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's obvious! The pyramid cannot exist without `many.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's obvious! The pyramid cannot exist without [color=#3b78e2][i]many.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That is incorrect. You didn't account for all the clues.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is stupid anyway!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How... How did you solve it?!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The letter `i` isn't in the word 'teamwork'.
nodes.text_bbcode: The letter [color=#3b78e2][i]i[/i][/color] isn't in the word 'teamwork'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Brendan said something yesterday about how you nerds value it so much.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So, you did your homework... Impressive...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's obvious who you are! You're Dex!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That is incorrect.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... I thought your name was Dex...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you not know how riddles work?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now I'm confused...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know how riddles work, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No one's allowed to sit here without answering Dex's Unsolvable Riddle first!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you even know who you're talking to?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I am talking to a human female rogue without a party! Do you know who `you're` talking to?
nodes.text_bbcode: I am talking to a human female rogue without a party! Do you know who [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] talking to?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A nerd, duh!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No! I am Dextrous Shadowguard. And it is my edict that all newcomers answer my Unsolvable Riddle or wear the Pendant of Shameful Silence!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Not the Pendant!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is going on `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is going on [color=#3b78e2][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's this... Thing he does.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We don't have a very high retainment rate at this table...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine... What's the riddle?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: 'I am very powerful...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I cannot exist without many...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yet 'I' is not in my name...'

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What am I?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, guys. Mind if I sit with you?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You want to... Sit? With us?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: There's a spot right here next to me. You can sit as close as you want.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll just, uh, sit next to Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So, I overheard you guys talking about tattoos.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm gonna get one of my motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Seems pretty tame, cuz.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I meant... A two-headed snake `riding` a motorcycle!
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant... A two-headed snake [color=#e23b3b][i]riding[/i][/color] a motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah. Rock on.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I've been thinking of getting a tattoo, too!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Really? Of what?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like... Maybe a butterfly on my ankle.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's so... Adorable.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That wasn't a compliment!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How about... A butterfly... Riding a motorcycle?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That makes no sense! How would it even steer?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How would your stupid two-headed snake steer?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: With its tongues of course!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, Blondie, you and I both know you don't belong here.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Why don't you try that table over there?
She points toward the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How embarrassing... I'm not even cool enough for the rebels!
Taylor sadly walks over to the nerds' table and prepares to sit down.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Halt!
Taylor walks over to the nerd table and sits...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Er... Welcome, Taylor!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're not mad at me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How could I be mad when my girlfriend chooses to sit with me?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Enough with the romantic discourse!
Taylor sinks down onto the bottom step...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that I'm not popular, what am I?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm a nothing.
Brendan sits down next to her and puts his arm around her, holding her tight.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is this the same girl who sat here on Homecoming and said she was happier `before` she became popular?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is this the same girl who sat here on Homecoming and said she was happier [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] she became popular?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I only said that because I was sad and delusional!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, pull yourself together!
Taylor takes a deep breath. Brendan looks into her eyes...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If it's any consolation, `I` don't think you're nothing. I think you're special. And who cares what anyone else thinks about you?
nodes.text_bbcode: If it's any consolation, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] don't think you're nothing. I think you're special. And who cares what anyone else thinks about you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, you're not going to believe this, but $ZOE had the nerve to say that `I` was an even worse Head Cheerleader than Jessica!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, you're not going to believe this, but $ZOE had the nerve to say that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was an even worse Head Cheerleader than Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Well...
Taylor pulls back from Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... I mean, she's kinda right, isn't she? I thought Sam quit the squad because of you... Just like you quit the squad because of Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So? This situation's totally different!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When I was Head Cheerleader, I was tough on Sam because she was always being combative!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In cheerleading, if you want to be the Head, you have to look down on everyone beneath you! That's why there's a pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know, we nerds have a rule in `Ogres and Elves...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, we nerds have a rule in [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You can't be a party leader until you've given Legendary gear to another player!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: English, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's a sacrifice... You give up something valuable to help the team. You can't be a good leader without being a good teammate first.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe it... You think I deserved to be punished, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, I'm not saying that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My own boyfriend is siding with my enemies!
Taylor gets up and starts to march away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks a lot for all your help! The next time I want to feel worse, I'll just text Jessica instead!
At lunch, the next day...
Taylor walks over and sits down at her spot at the Center Table...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Excuse me? Ex-cheerleaders don't belong here! Find another table!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can still sit here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't we let the table decide? If your friends support you, you can sit with us.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine with me!
Taylor scans the faces at the Center Table... No one makes eye contact.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, uh, guys?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just can't think of anyone who wants to be friends with a mean, deceitful, `former` Head... Who is also dating a nerd!
nodes.text_bbcode: I just can't think of anyone who wants to be friends with a mean, deceitful, [color=#3b78e2][i]former[/i][/color] Head... Who is also dating a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll sit somewhere else then!
Taylor stands up in a huff. She surveys the other tables...
At the swim team table...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great story, Sara! Your dad, er... Coach... Is tough!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I'll never eat lunch with Sam! I have to keep my standards!
At the rebel table...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: My next tattoo is going to be a dragon holding a flaming skull!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Mine is going to be a hot chick in a bikini getting a tattoo of an even hotter chick in a bikini!
And at the nerd table...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My new mage's character name is `Brendle the Wise!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My new mage's character name is [color=#e23b3b][i]Brendle the Wise![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I like it. Obviously, since it's you, he'll have high intellect...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: ...And low strength.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Where should I sit?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My fault?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! If you hadn't insisted we make out all the time, that video wouldn't exist, and I'd still be Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I apologize for getting joy out of making out with you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I apologize for thinking you're really pretty!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, you don't have to...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I'm sorry for liking you so much... Next time I want to express how I feel, I'll just offer you a handshake...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan, I didn't mean it! There's something else going on, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, what is it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Phew!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stupid Jessica! She does whatever she wants without ever considering what `I` want!
nodes.text_bbcode: Stupid Jessica! She does whatever she wants without ever considering what [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If it weren't for her, `I'd` still be running things!
nodes.text_bbcode: If it weren't for her, [color=#3b78e2][i]I'd[/i][/color] still be running things!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All done?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! She's dumb... And she's ugly. She's a dumb, ugly `ogre!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! She's dumb... And she's ugly. She's a dumb, ugly [color=#3b78e2][i]ogre![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I trusted her! I made her my number two, and she stabbed me right in the back!
Taylor flings her pom-poms to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She... She killed them!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm quitting this stupid team!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And all I want to know is... Who's coming with me?
Taylor looks across the cheerleaders' startled faces.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Sweet, lovable $ZOE. I `know` you hate Jessica just as much as I do.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE! Sweet, lovable $ZOE. I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] you hate Jessica just as much as I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But 'hate' is such a strong word.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How can you stay here now that this tyrant is in charge?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, Taylor... It's better than when you were Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Word.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You... You ungrateful... `Fine!` Enjoy your stupid lives!
nodes.text_bbcode: You... You ungrateful... [color=#3b78e2][i]Fine![/i][/color] Enjoy your stupid lives!

nodes.text: She storms off, furiously texting Brendan as she goes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nothing...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just give me the sweaty suit...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And for tonight's halftime show, the cheerleaders will be using this catapult to hurl our very own Lyle the Lizard mascot through this... `RING OF FIRE!`

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Catapult?! Ring of Fire?!`

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica, you said I was just going to be doing one flip onto a mountain of pillows!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So there's been a slight change of plans!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A `slight` change?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's nothing! Just aim your bulky lizard body `through` the ring.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! Is that all I have to do?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, unless you're thinking about quitting... You're not, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No... Just put me in the stupid catapult!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's so funny, Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I just imagined us storming a castle by hurling giant lizards at it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Just like King Arthur!
Taylor climbs into the catapult.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Have a nice flight!
Jessica pulls a lever, and Taylor flies through the air toward the Ring of Fire!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nooooooooo!
Taylor has always been `hot,` but this is a little extreme.
Sometimes, quitting is a good thing. Try again and see what happens!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Scratch it! Punch it! Bite it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor defends herself with a fury, delivering several crucial blows, including a punch that sends the goblin reeling back!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Take that!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the last of Brendle's blood leaves his body, he has time to impart one last message...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Remember, before you can become a leader... You must give up something of value...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: He dies... As the battle wages behind her, Taylor the Swift grieves, thinking about...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Forget grieving! I want to shoot...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I you, m'lady... And I you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... `You` do? Or `Brendle` does?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] do? Or [color=#3b78e2][i]Brendle[/i][/color] does?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Brendan does.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's the nicest thing anyone's ever said to... Brendle.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not saying it to Brendle... I'm saying it to Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I would do it again, for you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, Brendle.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'd sacrifice anything for you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How can you be so kind?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In this world, kindness is all that matters...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That... And earning enough XP to get a pet dragon!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Haha!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor holds his head up, gazing into his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor lightly strokes his face, gazing into his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love the smell of goblin dung after a victory!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Let's explore farther into their cave!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You enter into their cave, which spiderwebs out into a vast network of tunnels! In the corner is a treasure chest...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So... Now we just grab the treasure, and we're done, right?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Before you can say another word, the ground begins to rumble with the approach of something large and ominous...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe it's friendly!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You can hear a low roaring noise, primal, like a hungry lion that's caught the scent of blood!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We have to hide! Everyone, into the shadows!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll hide with Dextrous!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait! Why is Dex bossing us around all of a sudden?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor! There's a time for discussion, and there's a time for action. This is a time for action! Follow Dex!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I don't follow the orders of anyone!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Brendle,` come on! Leave her!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Brendle,[/i][/color] come on! Leave her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, hello? Why would we hide? Didn't we just dominate those goblin things?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just then, a great and terrible creature crashes into the cave. Its ugly, gargantuan body is hunched over, unable to stand fully upright under the fifteen-foot-high ceiling!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Rock shrapnel hits Taylor in the face, partially blinding her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Hey!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hey![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Its skin is a pale green, and it wields a mace the size of a full-grown human!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The ogre!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica... Where?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... Okay, not my first choice for a name, but I can't deny your spirit!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Jessica the Ogre` sees Brendle the Wise and Taylor the Swift standing in the middle of the cave! Taylor is closer! The ogre hefts its mace, winding up for a fatal blow on Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Jessica the Ogre[/i][/color] sees Brendle the Wise and Taylor the Swift standing in the middle of the cave! Taylor is closer! The ogre hefts its mace, winding up for a fatal blow on Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gulp! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, I yell at the ogre!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendle grabs the attention of the ogre! Instead of Taylor, it swings its mace at him!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't worry! It's okay! You can just roll high!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendle rolls a two! The mace slams into him, hurling his body into a stone wall with a dull `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Brendle rolls a two! The mace slams into him, hurling his body into a stone wall with a dull [color=#e23b3b][i]thud![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `NO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Vengeance! Kill the ogre!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Vengeance! Kill the ogre![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The party emerges from its hiding place, attacking the ogre!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I run over to, um, Brendle!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor swiftly runs over to Brendle! He's bent in a way that lets you know he's beyond healing... It's merely a matter of time...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Standing over the helpless goblin, Taylor sets an arrow in her bow, pulls it back taut, and...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! I can't stand idly by while this injustice transpires!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I knock Taylor the Swift out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendle the Wise barrels into Taylor at the very last minute! Her arrow just misses the goblin's neck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing, Brendan?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I should ask the same of you... On this team, we don't kill defenseless creatures! We aren't evil!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: While Brendle and Taylor are fighting, the goblin flees, terrified.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! He got away!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's what we wanted! And you would have known that if you had...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? Been a team player? It's like you're stuck on repeat! Save me the lecture!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I couldn't have said it better. What's next, Andrew?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift consults with her team...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He's defenseless... I say we let him go.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't disagree with Brendle! He's wise! It's in his name!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ditto for me. It just isn't right.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The group says... Let him go...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine... I'll... I'll let him go.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But if he double-crosses me...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The goblin thanks Taylor profusely and scampers down the cliff. On the other side of some brush, Taylor sees several baby goblins embrace him in a hug.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Baby goblins are called boblins!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... I didn't know he had a family!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That was the right thing to do...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought he might come back with his bigger goblin friends or something...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I meant you talking to us first... I know that wasn't easy for you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... Thanks!
Taylor rolls a twenty!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This game is easy!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's unbelievable!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not really. I had good odds!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No, you didn't! Do you even know how odds work?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up! I want to hear what happens!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift slams into the goblin headfirst!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Huh-ho! I really `pawned` him, didn't I?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh-ho! I really [color=#3b78e2][i]pawned[/i][/color] him, didn't I?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The other goblins flee, afraid of Taylor the Swift's wrath. The only remaining goblin is the one that Taylor rammed.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Helpless, it looks up at Taylor and pleads for its life!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Insult it!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's a goblin, not a cheerleader! What are you going to do? Tell it to go on a diet?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor, uh, tries to insult the goblin by implying it could stand to lose a few pounds...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Shock! The goblin is unfazed by your verbal jousting! It punches you, sending you reeling back!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Weak...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Furious, it leaps at Taylor, grabbing her!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: How does Taylor deal with this?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The goblin moves its head at just the last second, and the arrow misses high!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the goblin tries to wrench the club free, its arm is exposed! Taylor's arrow connects!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! Serves you right!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The goblin cries out in pain!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I fire at its... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: At its nothing! The goblin sees Taylor setting up the shot...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The goblin tries with all its might to wrench the club free!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want to shoot an arrow into the goblin thing!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor pulls back on her bow and fires at its...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor ducks out of the way! The club narrowly misses the top of her head and wedges itself into the cliff-face!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's right! Too slow, goblin thing!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor blocks the club! It connects with her arm with a loud crunch!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You've lost several hit points!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I want those?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes! How could you not know? What planet...?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can it, Dex!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The goblin takes another swing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Dodge!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And this time the goblin's club narrowly misses her, wedging into the cliff-face!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Too late! The club connects with her shoulder with a loud crunch!
Taylor rolls a twenty!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Great gravy!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Beginner's luck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Twenty... Is that good?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift skillfully disarms the trap... Along with two other `hidden traps!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor the Swift skillfully disarms the trap... Along with two other [color=#e23b3b][i]hidden traps![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet those would have hurt us something awful!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nice work, m'lady. Shall we continue onward?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We shall.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why would I help you if there's nothing in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... `Teamwork!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But... [color=#e23b3b][i]Teamwork![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't worry, guys! I've got this!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Not again...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Erik lumbers forward, reaching into the muck with his one remaining arm...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Roll two dice, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Rolling dice is where I shine!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That is simply false. You've rolled more 'ones' than any of us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Exactly! I'm a statistical anomaly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That means I'm due for a real whopper of a roll!
Erik rolls two ten-sided dice.
...and gets an eighteen!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hot dog! I knew my luck would change!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Unfortunately, your character needed a twenty to disarm that trap...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Spikes shoot out, severing your remaining arm!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've disarmed myself!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Too bad! Looks like we'll have to go back to the inn to heal!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No! We're sticking to our quest! We'll heal you later.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nuts! No arms, no inn.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's going to be a lot harder to kill the ogre now...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what? That could have been `my` arm!
nodes.text_bbcode: So what? That could have been [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] arm!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Let's just keep moving, okay?
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You step out of a hole in the dungeon and onto some steep cliffs!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The air out here is rank with the putrid stench of goblin dung.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Double-gross! Doesn't anything in this game smell good?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Be careful... Where there's goblin dung, there's...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Dung-eating beetles! My favorite!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Yes. But also, `goblins!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Yes. But also, [color=#e23b3b][i]goblins![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just then, goblins attack!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: In the chaos, Taylor and the biggest goblin get separated from the rest of the fight!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I cast Seraphic Protection on the party!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: An angelic creature wraps its wings around the party. The goblins' attacks are repelled by the spell.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes! We're safe!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Except for Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! She's out of the range of the spell!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The large goblin in front of Taylor swings its club at her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She has just enough time to...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll try to disarm the stupid thing.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift wades through the water and finds a trap.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! Sounds like it's all taken care of!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... You have to roll now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Roll? Like, roll out of the way?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Like roll these `dice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Like roll these [color=#e23b3b][i]dice![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew hands Taylor some dice.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... I hate to break it to you, but these dice look kind of weird. This one has, like, `twenty` sides!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I hate to break it to you, but these dice look kind of weird. This one has, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]twenty[/i][/color] sides!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's by design!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Don't worry, you still `roll` it just like a normal six-sided die.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, you still [color=#e23b3b][i]roll[/i][/color] it just like a normal six-sided die.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh... Do you think I could hold onto that bow? It's customary for me to protect our most valuable items...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fat chance. It may be imaginary and lame, but I'm holding onto this.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's all I've got...
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You enter a dungeon devoid of light. Brackish water festers at your feet as the screams of were-rats echo throughout the dark chamber.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A few feet in front of you, bones peek through the water.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This looks like trap city!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll go!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: For the last time, Erik, you're a half-giant barbarian with one arm and only three dexterity!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Every time you try to disarm a trap, you get mortally wounded, and we have to walk back to town!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love healing up at the inn!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift is a ranger. She's probably the best choice for disarming traps...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This sounds dangerous... What do I get if I do this?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Experience!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Life tip. Never do `anything` when someone tells you it's just for the experience.
nodes.text_bbcode: Life tip. Never do [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] when someone tells you it's just for the experience.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, Taylor... It would really help the `team.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Taylor... It would really help the [color=#e23b3b][i]team.[/i][/color]

nodes.prompt: It would really help the team.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: It would really help the team.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No one insults me and lives! I draw my sword!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Angie Elfendale draws her sword and holds it menacingly in front of Taylor the Swift!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She can't do that! Can't I, like, shoot her or something?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift draws her `legendary Bow of Ogre-Slaying` and points an arrow in Angie Elfendale's direction.
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor the Swift draws her [color=#e23b3b][i]legendary Bow of Ogre-Slaying[/i][/color] and points an arrow in Angie Elfendale's direction.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hold, fair Angie Elfendale! Taylor the Swift bears a Bow of Ogre-Slaying!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet you can slay ogres with that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I'm guessing that would include the `huge ogre` that the townsfolk have asked us to kill!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm guessing that would include the [color=#e23b3b][i]huge ogre[/i][/color] that the townsfolk have asked us to kill!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Will it slay elves too?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Let's, uh, not be so hasty. I'll put my sword away, okay?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. That's what I thought. This game `is` fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. That's what I thought. This game [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] fun!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You seem like a fine warrior! We'd sure be glad to have you on our team!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I knew this was stupid. I'll just watch you guys play.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, but if you don't play, you have to go. Those are the rules of the table.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sigh. Okay. Um... Maybe my character can just kill everyone?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Wow. Okay. Taylor the Swift draws her `legendary Bow of Ogre-Slaying` and points an arrow in Dextrous's direction!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Okay. Taylor the Swift draws her [color=#e23b3b][i]legendary Bow of Ogre-Slaying[/i][/color] and points an arrow in Dextrous's direction!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's a blatant violation of the Laughing Hill Treaty of '03!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can I shoot him? Please?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait! Didn't you guys hear? She's got a Bow of Ogre-Slaying!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet you can slay ogres with that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I'm guessing that would include the `huge ogre` that the townsfolk have asked us to kill!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm guessing that would include the [color=#e23b3b][i]huge ogre[/i][/color] that the townsfolk have asked us to kill!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So you're coming with us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Unless you want to eat lunch alone...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... Fine. But as soon as we kill this thing, lame fantasy time is over!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift was a ranger with high agility, lethal proficiency with a bow and arrow...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I like that...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And a deep hatred of elves!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh! I'm an elf!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Angie Elfendale spoke...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: H-Hello, miss, where might you be traveling to?

nodes.prompt: How do you reply to Angie Elfendale?

options.label: I don't talk to pointy-eared idiots!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: How do you reply to Angie Elfendale?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. That sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If you don't pick a name, I'll be forced to give you one!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is so stupid!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just play along...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Party Pooper in three... Two... One...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! I'll be Taylor the... Swift!
Thirty seconds later...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Twas a cold, rainy day in the town of Laughing Hill...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks for agreeing to play, Taylor... I owe you one.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: One? You owe me, like `a hundred!`
nodes.text_bbcode: One? You owe me, like [color=#e23b3b][i]a hundred![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What do I do? Where's the board?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just listen for now...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...And the four intrepid adventurers...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Led by `Dextrous Shadowguard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Led by [color=#e23b3b][i]Dextrous Shadowguard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: ...Decided to stay the night at a local inn to keep dry.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love inns! I hope to own one someday! I'll call it `The Innie,` like my belly button!
nodes.text_bbcode: I love inns! I hope to own one someday! I'll call it [color=#e23b3b][i]The Innie,[/i][/color] like my belly button!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A fire was crackling, and they settled down before it...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: These small town inns are so quaint! I want to find someone to talk to!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The charismatic `Angie Elfendale` decided to strike up a conversation with a roguish-looking girl named Taylor the...
nodes.text_bbcode: The charismatic [color=#e23b3b][i]Angie Elfendale[/i][/color] decided to strike up a conversation with a roguish-looking girl named Taylor the...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor `the...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor [color=#e23b3b][i]the...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Ahem!` Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahem![/i][/color] Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're supposed to pick a nickname here, something that describes your character's qualities.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Qualities?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well... Your character is very `fast.` Maybe... Taylor the Expedient?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Your character is very [color=#e23b3b][i]fast.[/i][/color] Maybe... Taylor the Expedient?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ew... No! I'm not a website.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So what's it going to be? Taylor the...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Suddenly, it charges at her like a bull!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Charge back!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's the hold up?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Your character isn't really the charging type.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wasn't talking to you, you dumb elf!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually, I guess that's in-character...
Andrew hands Taylor the twenty-sided die...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You could jeopardize the entire quest!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do I need to roll?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: At least an eighteen...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is...
Five minutes later, Taylor meets with Brendan at the steps where they first kissed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hi...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I got your text. I'm so sorry... But I think you did the right thing by quitting.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I feel... I don't know... Proud of you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan! You're so sweet...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you don't know `what` you're talking about!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you don't know [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My reputation might have taken a big blow when $ZOE publicized that video of us kissing, but `at least` I was still a cheerleader!
nodes.text_bbcode: My reputation might have taken a big blow when $ZOE publicized that video of us kissing, but [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] I was still a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that I've quit the squad, I'm completely ruined!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not like you'll ever understand social drama! All you know is math and rolling dice and making weird sounds!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Urrrrb...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Have I done something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This whole thing is all...
Just then, Hannah and Zach walk by.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Beep, beep, beep. My `nerd alert` is going off.
nodes.text_bbcode: Beep, beep, beep. My [color=#3b78e2][i]nerd alert[/i][/color] is going off.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. 'Beep'.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This 'nerd alert' is a highly implausible device. To quantify a personality trait is practically...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `BEEP!` These readings are off the chart!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]BEEP![/i][/color] These readings are off the chart!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! 'Chart'.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait a second... `Taylor?` What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor?[/i][/color] What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

options.label: Making fun of the nerds too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The ogre!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift turns to the ogre! She lets an arrow fly, but it misses!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? It's an `ogre!` How could I miss?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? It's an [color=#3b78e2][i]ogre![/i][/color] How could I miss?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The ogre slams its mace into a stone pillar, collapsing part of the cave and trapping the rest of the party in the corner!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fire another arrow!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor lets another arrow fly! This one misses too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The ogre takes a menacing step toward the party and raises its mace for an easy, vicious kill!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're partially blind, Taylor! It's affecting your aim!
Taylor takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I must give up something of value.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You got it...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No talking, Brendle! You're dead!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm a mentor from beyond the grave!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oh... Never mind. That's really cool. Nice ad-lib.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Play resumes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can anyone else fire a bow?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can! Name your mark, and Erik the Erik will hit it!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Erik! Your dexterity is 3, and last I checked, you need two arms to fire a bow! You couldn't hit a giant, paralyzed sea slug with a charmed crossbow!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Well, I can still kick really hard!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I can fire a bow!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: An elf? I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This isn't the time for petty gripes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Geez! Just staying in character.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I throw my bow to Angie Elfendale!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor the Swift heroically launches her Bow of Ogre-Slaying toward Angie Elfendale, who catches it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I fire at the ogre!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just as the ogre's mace is about to slam into the party, Angie Elfendale's arrow connects with the ogre's eye!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's a critical hit!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Jessica the Ogre is slain!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So, we won?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Loot the cave!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The adventurers search the cave for treasure and find a hoard of gold!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We're rich!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can finally build `The Innie!` Let's go!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can finally build [color=#e23b3b][i]The Innie![/i][/color] Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll create a new character and meet you there!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not long after, the adventurers leave the cave and return to the town of Laughing Hill, where they are treated like heroes!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Huzzah!
Brendan leans over to Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: By table rules, you can be our leader next time...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If I want to be...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You... Don't want to be leader?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm kidding! Of course I do! Next time, I'm going to make sure everyone has matching armor!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Great sacrifices, guys!
The nerds celebrate and cheer. Taylor smiles...
But then the Center Table catches her eye. She looks at it wistfully...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be back, I promise. But I'll be different...
Looks like Taylor and her new nerd friends totally pwned Jessica the Ogre!
Taylor also survived a goblin attack, had a heartfelt moment with Brendle the Wise, and learned a valuable lesson about teamwork!
And she couldn't have done it without your help! You played a great game!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Dex!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because there can be only `one` leader of this team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because there can be only [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] leader of this team!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Traitor! You'll never get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... Roll the dice, Taylor.
She rolls... A twenty!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Wow... Uh, okay... Critical hit. Dex's spleen explodes.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoa brother! I know how painful spleen injuries can be!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did I say you could speak?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Dex never made us ask for permission...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can I shoot Erik too?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. Roll.
Five minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Wow!` How many twenties can one person roll?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wow![/i][/color] How many twenties can one person roll?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want to shoot another arrow at someone!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You've already wiped us out.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Only the ogre remains... And frankly, he seems a little scared of you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Perfect. I tell him that if he wants to live he has to be my servant.
Andrew rolls a few dice.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The ogre agrees to serve you for all his days!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excellent. Time for me and the ogre to go destroy the town.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not the inn!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're dead. No talking!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... I don't understand... What about the `team?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But... I don't understand... What about the [color=#e23b3b][i]team?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The only team I need is `my` team... Just me and the ogre!
nodes.text_bbcode: The only team I need is [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] team... Just me and the ogre!

nodes.text: Well... This isn't how our adventure should end at all!
This isn't quite what Brendan had in mind when he was talking about teamwork...
Try again and see if you can earn an ending where Taylor doesn't go rogue!

Later that day...
...And then she was actually `rolling dice` with the nerds!
Haha. Nice work. Hey, you want to come out and celebrate tonight?
I never say no to a party!
Later, at `Angst,` the popular downtown club...
Thanks again for all the advice! It was totes helpful in destroying Taylor!
Are you kidding? I've been wanting to take Taylor down for years!
Back when `I` used to be Head Cheerleader, I let her get too powerful, and she turned on me...
It was too late before I realized I'd created a monster.
Yeah. She got out of control.
Well, my grandma just sent me a huge `wad of cash` for my birthday!
Paula holds up a bunch of money...
Let's spend it all to celebrate our victory!
Actually, to celebrate `my` victory, I'm gonna go make out with that hot guy over there!
I hate to break it to you, but James and I are `kind of` an item right now.
And, anyway, I thought you were trying to get together with that Ben guy?
I `am` trying to go out with Ben... But that doesn't mean I can't make out with whoever I want!
You think you can just steal James from me? I'd `love` to see you try!
Jessica taps a nearby bouncer on the shoulder.
Is there a problem here?
Yes! This crazy chick just stole a bunch of money from the cash register!
The bouncer looks at the wad of bills in Paula's hand.
Wait a second! This is my money, I...
You can explain it all to the cops. Let's go, honey.
You won't get away with this!
I already have.
I've... I've created another monster, haven't I?
The bouncer drags Paula away.
Hey, hot stuff. Looking `super` cute tonight!
I... Am?
Uh oh... It looks like the apprentice has become the master!
Can `anyone` stop Jessica now?
Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene. See you next week!

nodes.text: It's the Monday after Thanksgiving, and the cheerleading squad has reconvened for practice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh. Practice is a lot less fun when I don't get to tell everyone what to do...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And why is everybody `smiling?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And why is everybody [color=#3b78e2][i]smiling?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm `still` full!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] full!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It was nice to have a Thanksgiving where I actually got to eat...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... It's way better than when Taylor was in charge.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! Everything I did, I did for the sake of the squad! You were all getting soft!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I like soft things!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I have to admit, I was dubious at first... But I'm starting to really like having Jessica as our Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes glad to hear it, Jill! Just for that, I'm moving you up a notch! Take off that sweaty lizard suit!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You... You mean I don't have to be the mascot anymore?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nope! But someone else will have to fill those ugly, green shoes... Who should it be?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hmm... Let's see... Eeeny Meeeny Miney... Oh, who am I kidding? It's `Taylor!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... Let's see... Eeeny Meeeny Miney... Oh, who am I kidding? It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hope you're not claustrophobic!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's `it!` First, you put me at the bottom of the pyramid...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]it![/i][/color] First, you put me at the bottom of the pyramid...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then I had to wash everyone's `disgusting` underwear!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I had to wash everyone's [color=#3b78e2][i]disgusting[/i][/color] underwear!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey! My underwear is very clean!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up, Keith! This mascot thing is the last straw!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you saying?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is...
